messages:
Kevin (AP): Invoice INV-24678 from Aurora Systems landed in the shared payables inbox but there's no PO attached in Coupa. PDF is in the thread. Anyone know which PO this should hit?
Anna (Finance): Looks like vendor put our old legal entity on the invoice (Redwood Labs LLC) instead of Redwood Inference Inc. That will block auto-match. Can you attach the PDF here?
Kevin (AP): Attached. Invoice total is $12,480. PO search for PO-93421 returns nothing. Vendor says payment terms net30.
Aurora Billing: Hi team — we sent INV-24678 under the account code RU-Labs per the vendor portal. We can reissue with the correct entity if you confirm the PO number. Apologies for the mix.
Lisa (Platform): If it's the same spend, we might be able to match to PO-2026-PLAT-77 (platform infra reserved). @Anna can you confirm cost center?
Anna (Finance): Cost center should be ENG-PLATFORM. If matching to PO-2026-PLAT-77 we need the vendor to reissue with Redwood Inference Inc and PO on the invoice. Otherwise AP can't auto-approve.
Kevin (AP): Okay — I'll ask vendor to reissue. Quick question: is it acceptable to process a one-off vendor credit against the wrong entity and then post an intercompany correction later? That adds 2-3 days and manual work.
Anna (Finance): We prefer reissue. Intercompany corrections are tedious and increase audit friction. Please request reissued invoice with PO on it.
Aurora Billing: We can reissue same amount and reference PO-2026-PLAT-77. Expect new PDF within 24 hours. Do you want net30 preserved?
Kevin (AP): Yes, preserve net30. Also, adding @lisa-platform as an approver in Coupa would speed routing — currently approval chain ends at Eng Ops which is slow.
Lisa (Platform): I can be added. Can AP/Finance request routing change? Looks like current approver is Eng Ops manager only.
coupa-bot: Routing change request for vendor Aurora Systems has been logged (REQ-8892). Pending admin approval.
Anna (Finance): Thanks. Kevin, once reissued invoice arrives drop it here and I'll upload and attempt match against PO-2026-PLAT-77. If it still fails, we'll escalate to procurement for manual attach.
Kevin (AP): Will do — closing for now but will follow up as soon as reissued PDF is in. :thumbsup:
